briefdescription.para: Registers font bytes with a typeface and returns the entry index.

detaileddescription.para: The build command shares this function to load the font that it just wrote, so both commands read a font through one path.

parameterdescription.para: The typeface that takes the registration.
The font file; named in the failure message.

simplesect.para: The index of the registered entry in typeface.

detaileddescription.para: Reads the font named by --extract and the manifest named by --manifest. Every outline and advance is scaled from the font's units per em to the sheet's units per em, and drawn into a raw sheet: one cell per character above the space, plus one cell per ligature that shaping finds. A manifest without a glyphs table gains one built from the raw sheet, and is written back. The sheet is then laid out from the manifest's glyphs table, so only the cells that the table lists are written, to the path that the weight table named by --weight gives. The manifest metrics are read and never changed.

parameterdescription.para: The parsed command line arguments; must carry --extract, --manifest and --weight.
